scholarships.name: Endowed Scholarships
scholarships.description: An endowed scholarship is a permanent fund established through donor gifts, where the principal is invested and only a portion of the earnings is used each year to provide scholarship support for students. This ensures the scholarship can continue assisting students for generations to come.

scholarships.name: Donor-Funded Scholarships
scholarships.description: A donor-funded scholarship is supported by contributions made directly by an individual, family, organization, or business to provide immediate financial assistance to students. These funds are typically awarded from current-use gifts rather than investment earnings. /* =============================
